messages:
shiv: Heads-up — we're about to flip the notify-routing v2 rollout that will retroactively surface alert counts for older SLOs. This could backfill a lot of alerts into tenants' consoles. Anyone worried about noise?

mae: Yeah — this can spike both console noise and paging. We should avoid generating new pages for historical samples. Options: `backfill` flag, `suppress_escalation` header, or route to a preview bucket.

jordan: My vote is a `backfill=true` marker so downstream systems can treat these as telemetry-only initially. That keeps burn/history visible without firing on-call.

cory: Quotas are another risk. If we re-send thousands of samples per SLO, notify QPS and per-tenant limits will be hit. Need soft rate-limits for backfill paths.

mae: Minimal API change suggestion: accept `X-Redwood-Backfill: true` and `X-Redwood-Suppress-Escalation: true` headers. No schema change to payload.

jordan: Also add telemetry: `notify.backfill.count` with tags `slo_id` and `tenant_id` so we can track volume separately.

cory: Console UX idea: show a "Backfill preview" card that lists number of historical alerts and a badge: "not paged". Include an affordance: `Promote to live` per-tenant or per-SLO.

alert-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for notify-routing v2 -> prod us-west-2 :rocket:

mae: Quick config example for the ingest path:
```http
POST /notify/v2 HTTP/1.1
Host: notify.redwood.internal
X-Redwood-Backfill: true
X-Redwood-Suppress-Escalation: true
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "slo_id": "slo_abc123",
  "window_start": "2026-03-20T00:00:00Z",
  "samples": 1200
}
```

jordan: On the rollout plan: treat backfill events as telemetry-only for the first 24 hours per SLO. After that, if tenant opts in, they can flip to full alerts. We'll surface in the console a toggle in the SLO details.

cory: For infra: add a per-tenant backfill rate limiter and a global backfill token bucket. Defaults: 1000 backfill samples/hr per-tenant, 100k/hr global (tunable).

shiv: Good. Action items: 1) API header & server-side check (mae) 2) prometheus metric + grafana (jordan) 3) console preview card + toggle (cory/product) 4) infra rate-limiter and quota bump guardrails (eng-infra). Can we ship a small safety-first patch?

mae: I'll open a PR for the header/handler and unit tests today. Will add a fast path to ignore `suppress_escalation` by default if header absent.

jordan: I'll instrument a new counter and add a Grafana row under the notify dashboard labeled "Backfill ingestion".

cory: Mocking up the UI now, will post screenshots in #eng-platform later. Draft copy: "These alerts are historical — they won't trigger on-call unless promoted."

alert-bot: opsbot: canary checks passed: notify-routing v2 canary succeeded :white_check_mark: (3/3)

shiv: Thanks all. Keep the defaults conservative. If any unexpected pagers happen during the canary, @shiv please ping immediately.

mae: noted. I'll add guard-metrics and an emergency kill-switch env var `NOTIFY_BACKFILL_ENABLED=false`.

jordan: Added runbook note for ops: "If backfill spike observed -> set env var false, revert canary".

cory: I'll coordinate with product to ensure phrasing avoids confusion for customers.

shiv: Perfect. Closing loop — update thread when PRs/graphs are ready. :thumbsup:
